correctness_confidence.basis: Hand-checked: the squared-residual identity (3), the Lemma 4 separation bound, the Lemma 5 Cauchy estimate, Prop. 6 arithmetic and the explicit n>=10^4 certificate for eq. (2), and the Thm 3 upper-bound limit 1/8 from the Gaussian ratio. No error found. Not checked line by line: the Thm 2 and Thm 11 parameter systems, the IFT and Lemma 10 existence step, and the numerical bound in Lemma A.1(e).

rigor.basis: Constants in Thm 1 and eq. (2) are traceable. Thm 2 is non-effective: the IFT neighbourhood is unquantified and M_A, C_A, N_A are not computed, as the paper admits. The Thm 3 tail step ('a polynomial times a Gaussian dominates') is asserted, not written out. Prop. A.5 has a compressed proof.

novelty.basis: Thm 1 is presented as a refinement of Tan et al. and of the qualitative Luo-Yang-Zhu result, and the Erdos 973 negative answer is conceded as prior. The sharp 1/sqrt(8) circle-root constant and the one-interior-zero collapse appear new in the text. The prior-art claims rest on arXiv items (2607.22017, 2608.02043, Komarov) that I could not check.

significance.basis: Relevant to exterior power sums and root-residual barriers. The zero-count statement (no interior zero: no collapse; one interior zero: restricted residual O(n^{-1/6})) is clean and citable. Superalgebraic decay (Thm 2) is non-effective, and the one-root rate is not optimal (Sec. 8), which limits impact.

reproducibility.basis: The PDF contains no code, no numerical tables and no supplementary artifact. It refers to supplementary diagnostics, a grid evaluation and quadrature checks that are not provided. Thm 2 and Thm 11 rely on solving systems by IFT or numerically, which the text does not reproduce.

summary: Version-2 manuscript on residuals ||P' - lambda P|| / ||P|| for polynomials with all zeros in the closed unit disk. Main claims: (i) for all-circle-zero polynomials the unrestricted and restricted infima tend to 1/sqrt(8) (Thm 3); (ii) s_n >= exp(-C sqrt(n)) for every C > sqrt((8/3) log 17), and s_n >= exp(-3 sqrt(n)) for n >= 10^4 (Thm 1, eq. 2); (iii) one interior zero permits restricted residual O(n^{-1/6}) (Thm 11), while superalgebraic decay for every A > 0 needs finitely many interior zeros (Thm 2). I hand-checked the identities and constants of the main lower-bound and upper-bound arguments and found no error. The Thm 2 and Thm 11 constructions were checked only at the level of moment identities and exponent bookkeeping. Recommendation: major revision for verification, effective constants and prior-art documentation.
strengths: The Mathieu-based lower bound in Sec. 2 is clean: identity (3) checks, and the expansion E(L) = a0(2L)/4 with E(L) = -L + sqrt(L/2) - 1/16 matches the standard a0 asymptotics.
The finite certificate (Prop. 6) gives an explicit path to exp(-3 sqrt(n)) for n >= 10^4; the arithmetic I checked holds (K <= (14/19) sqrt(n) + 1, a/r <= 16, 1/(K eta) <= 10/21, B < 1/(5n)).
The upper-bound family P_{m,k} in Thm 3 checks: P'(0) = n/2 + 1/4, P'(1)/P(1) = n/2, and the Gaussian ratio with variance 1/6 gives exactly 1/8.
The paper scopes its claims honestly: Thm 2 is non-effective, the one-root rate is not claimed optimal, and the Erdos 973 negative answer is credited to prior work.
weaknesses: Thm 2 depends on an implicit-function neighbourhood that is never quantified and on Lemma 10, whose existence argument is sketched. M_A, C_A and N_A are not computed, so the superalgebraic claim is an existence statement with unverified steps.

The Thm 11 rate O(n^{-1/6}) rests on Prop. A.5 with K = 3. Its proof is compressed, and the solving of (a_n, c_n) from D and T, with the uniformity over 34 residue classes, is described but not written out.
The Thm 3 dominated-convergence step on the outer arc is asserted, not proved.
Priority and novelty claims rely on preprints (Tan et al., Luo et al., Komarov) and on a 2020 journal version that the author states was not available. None of these were checked.
The PDF header says version 2 (21 October 2026), while the review template field says v1. This is not a mathematical defect but should be reconciled before release.
No code, numerical tables or supplementary checks are included, so the numerical claims in Lemma A.1(e) and Sec. 8 cannot be reproduced from the artifact.
potential_errors: Unconfirmed: Sec. 6 states P'(0) = P'(1)/P(1) as an 'exact identity' from (13)-(15). It holds because each interior factor satisfies f'(0) - f'(1)/f(1) = -v^2/(v-1) = d(v), so the first-moment equation enforces it, but this step is not written out and should be stated explicitly.
strong_novelty_candidates: The sharp circle-root constant 1/sqrt(8) for both the unrestricted and the restricted residual (Thm 3), provided the prior literature does not already contain it.
The minimal interior-root count: zero interior zeros cannot collapse the residual (Thm 3), while one interior zero does, at rate O(n^{-1/6}) (Thm 11).
